pairs.registryProposal: Two lessons. (1) The evidence floor counts every technique of a subject, so a context that is one seat of a 31-technique subject can only ever be deviation or unknown; propose counting only the techniques whose precondition holds here. (2) Application candidate for agent-memory / decay-and-forgetting: this repo (ADR 0143) shows fade as rank-only demotion with report-only forget proposals, and a person's forget as a retired marker fact with supersedes on write-once replicated files - a replication-safe form of the tombstone that the technique does not yet describe; it also shows the gap the technique warns of (the marker is written, nothing consults it before minting).
